visual_review.sky: Both learned outputs remove most visible grain and look close; independently exposed ISO100 is qualitative only.
visual_review.building: The learned methods remain close, with softened fine bracket/truss detail.
visual_review.foliage: Both retain the broad leaf shapes but soften fine texture; no clear broad benefit is established.
visual_review.fence: Both retain continuous mesh lines. Small local differences do not establish a new winner.
visual_review.exact_GT: Fine fabric cords remain missing and fabric color differs from GT. Building edges are clean but cloud detail is softened. Two examples cannot establish broad quality.

decision.next: Finish B and full matched numerical, native, analytic and full-frame GFX review.
